verdict.rationale: Zep has no native natural-language command interface. Its official Memory MCP Server does let end users reach their agent memory in Zep through MCP clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, so they can work with memory conversationally through those assistants. The separate Graphiti MCP server, which lets assistants interact with Context Graph capabilities, is explicitly experimental. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command surface for operating or administering Zep, evidence that MCP access covers operations beyond memory reads and writes, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Memory MCP Server lets an end user connect an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) client (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) to their own agent memory in Zep.
This enables AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code with Copilot to interact with Graphiti's Context Graph capabilities, providing persistent context and contextual awareness.
The Graphiti MCP Server is an experimental implementation that exposes Graphiti's key functionality through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
